column2:
abandon(v.)拋棄、放棄
abandoned(adj.)被拋棄的、廢棄的
abandonment(n.)拋棄、放棄
abandon a plan 放棄計畫
abandoned building 廢棄建築
The crew had to abandon the sinking ship.
(船員們不得不棄船逃生。)
Many abandoned dogs are waiting for new homes.
(許多被遺棄的狗正在等待新家。)

absolute(adj.)絕對的、完全的
absolutely(adv.)絕對地、完全地
absolute truth 絕對的真理
absolute silence 一片寂靜
There was absolute silence in the exam room.
(考場裡一片寂靜。)
I have absolute trust in my best friend.
(我完全信任我最好的朋友。)

absorb(v.)吸收、使專心
absorption(n.)吸收
absorbed(adj.)專心的
absorb water 吸水
be absorbed in 專注於
Plants absorb water through their roots.
(植物透過根部吸收水分。)
He was so absorbed in the novel that he missed his stop.
(他太專注於那本小說，結果坐過站了。)

abstract(adj.)抽象的
abstraction(n.)抽象概念
abstract idea 抽象概念
abstract art 抽象藝術
Love is an abstract idea that is hard to explain.
(愛是一個難以解釋的抽象概念。)
I don't really understand abstract art.
(我不太懂抽象藝術。)

academic(adj.)學術的、學業的
academy(n.)學院、專科學校
academically(adv.)學業上
academic performance 學業表現
academic year 學年
Her academic performance has improved this year.
(她今年的學業表現進步了。)
The new academic year starts in September.
(新學年從九月開始。)

accent(n.)口音、重音
accented(adj.)帶口音的
a strong accent 濃重的口音
British accent 英國腔
He speaks English with a strong Spanish accent.
(他說英文帶有濃重的西班牙口音。)
Where does the accent fall in this word?
(這個字的重音在哪裡？)

acceptance(n.)接受、認可
accept(v.)接受
acceptable(adj.)可接受的
acceptance letter 錄取通知
gain acceptance 獲得認可
She received an acceptance letter from the university.
(她收到了大學的錄取通知書。)
The new idea slowly gained acceptance.
(這個新想法慢慢獲得了認可。)

access(n./v.)接近、使用權、存取
accessible(adj.)可接近的、可使用的
have access to 能使用、能接近
Internet access 網路連線
All students have access to the school library.
(所有學生都可以使用學校圖書館。)
You need a password to access this website.
(你需要密碼才能進入這個網站。)

accidental(adj.)意外的、偶然的
accident(n.)意外
accidentally(adv.)意外地、不小心
accidental death 意外死亡
accidental discovery 意外的發現
The discovery of the medicine was accidental.
(這種藥的發現是個意外。)
I accidentally deleted the file.
(我不小心把檔案刪掉了。)

accompany(v.)陪伴、伴隨、為⋯伴奏
companion(n.)同伴
accompaniment(n.)伴奏
be accompanied by 由⋯陪同
accompany on the piano 用鋼琴伴奏
Children must be accompanied by an adult.
(孩童必須由成人陪同。)
She accompanied her grandmother to the hospital.
(她陪奶奶去醫院。)

accomplish(v.)完成、達成、accomplishment(n.)成就
accomplished(adj.)有造詣的、熟練的
accomplish a goal 達成目標
a great accomplishment 偉大的成就
With teamwork, we accomplished the task on time.
(靠著團隊合作，我們準時完成了任務。)
Winning the prize was a great accomplishment for her.
(得獎對她來說是一項了不起的成就。)

accountant(n.)會計師
account(n.)帳戶、帳目
accounting(n.)會計學
certified accountant 合格會計師
hire an accountant 聘請會計師
My mother works as an accountant at a bank.
(我媽媽在銀行擔任會計。)
The company hired an accountant to check its records.
(公司聘請了一位會計師查帳。)

accuracy(n.)準確、精確
accurate(adj.)準確的
accurately(adv.)準確地
with accuracy 準確地
check the accuracy 檢查正確性
Please check the accuracy of your answers.
(請檢查你答案的正確性。)
The weather report was given with great accuracy.
(這份氣象預報非常準確。)

accuse(v.)控告、指責
accusation(n.)指控
accuse... of 指控⋯犯了
the accused 被告
He was accused of stealing a bike.
(他被指控偷了一輛腳踏車。)
Don't accuse me of lying without proof.
(沒有證據就別指責我說謊。)

acid(n./adj.)酸、酸性的
acidic(adj.)酸性的
acid rain 酸雨
citric acid 檸檬酸
Acid rain can damage forests and lakes.
(酸雨會破壞森林和湖泊。)
Lemons contain a lot of citric acid.
(檸檬含有大量檸檬酸。)

acquaintance(n.)熟人、認識、了解
acquaint(v.)使認識、使熟悉
make one's acquaintance 結識某人
a casual acquaintance 泛泛之交
He is not a close friend, just an acquaintance.
(他不是密友，只是認識的人。)
I made her acquaintance at a summer camp.
(我在夏令營認識了她。)

acquire(v.)獲得、習得
acquisition(n.)獲得、習得
acquire knowledge 獲得知識
acquire a skill 習得技能
Children acquire language very quickly.
(孩子學習語言非常快。)
She acquired many useful skills during her internship.
(她在實習期間學到很多實用技能。)

adapt(v.)適應、改編
adaptation(n.)適應、改編作品
adaptable(adj.)能適應的
adapt to 適應⋯
be adapted from 改編自
It took me a month to adapt to my new school.
(我花了一個月適應新學校。)
The film was adapted from a popular novel.
(這部電影改編自一本暢銷小說。)

addict(n./v.)上癮者、使上癮
addiction(n.)上癮、成癮
addicted(adj.)上癮的
be addicted to 對⋯上癮
game addict 遊戲成癮者
Many teenagers are addicted to their phones.
(許多青少年對手機上癮。)
He used to be a game addict, but he has changed.
(他以前是遊戲成癮者，但現在已經改變了。)

adequate(adj.)足夠的、適當的
adequately(adv.)足夠地
adequate sleep 充足的睡眠
adequate supply 充足的供應
Teenagers need adequate sleep to stay healthy.
(青少年需要充足的睡眠以保持健康。)
The room is small but adequate for two people.
(這房間雖小，但兩個人住剛好夠。)

adjust(v.)調整、適應、adjustment(n.)調整、適應
adjustable(adj.)可調整的
adjust to 適應⋯
make an adjustment 做調整
You can adjust the height of this chair.
(你可以調整這張椅子的高度。)
It took him time to adjust to life in the city.
(他花了一段時間才適應城市生活。)

admirable(adj.)令人欽佩的、值得讚賞的
admire(v.)欽佩、讚賞
admiration(n.)欽佩
admirable effort 令人欽佩的努力
admirable courage 令人敬佩的勇氣
Her courage in the face of danger was admirable.
(她面對危險時的勇氣令人欽佩。)
He made an admirable effort to help the poor.
(他為幫助窮人付出了令人敬佩的努力。)

admiration(n.)欽佩、讚賞
admire(v.)欽佩、讚賞
admirable(adj.)令人欽佩的
with admiration 欽佩地
deep admiration 深深的欽佩
The students looked at the scientist with admiration.
(學生們欽佩地看著那位科學家。)
I have great admiration for doctors and nurses.
(我非常欽佩醫生和護理師。)

admission(n.)入場(許可)、入學許可、承認
admit(v.)承認、准許進入
admission fee 入場費
free admission 免費入場
Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
(週日博物館免費入場。)
She applied for admission to a top university.
(她申請進入一所頂尖大學就讀。)

adopt(v.)收養、採用
adoption(n.)收養、採用
adopted(adj.)被收養的
adopt a child 收養孩子
adopt a plan 採用計畫
They adopted a cat from the animal shelter.
(他們從動物收容所領養了一隻貓。)
The school adopted a new uniform policy.
(學校採用了新的制服規定。)

agency(n.)代理商、機構、仲介
agent(n.)代理人
travel agency 旅行社
government agency 政府機構
We booked our trip through a travel agency.
(我們透過旅行社預訂了行程。)
The agency helps people find jobs.
(這家仲介公司幫助人們找工作。)

agent(n.)代理人、經紀人、特務
agency(n.)代理商、機構
travel agent 旅行業者
secret agent 特務
The singer's agent arranged the concert.
(那位歌手的經紀人安排了演唱會。)
He plays a secret agent in the new movie.
(他在新電影中飾演一名特務。)

aggressive(adj.)具攻擊性的、積極進取的
aggression(n.)攻擊、侵略
aggressively(adv.)具侵略性地
aggressive behavior 攻擊性行為
aggressive dog 兇猛的狗
Stay away from that dog; it's aggressive.
(離那隻狗遠一點，牠很兇。)
The company has an aggressive plan to expand.
(那家公司有積極擴張的計畫。)

agreeable(adj.)令人愉快的、欣然同意的
agree(v.)同意
agreement(n.)協議、同意
agreeable weather 宜人的天氣
be agreeable to 同意⋯
We spent an agreeable evening with friends.
(我們和朋友度過了一個愉快的夜晚。)
Is your father agreeable to the plan?
(你爸爸同意這個計畫嗎？)

alcohol(n.)酒精、酒
alcoholic(adj./n.)含酒精的、酗酒者
drink alcohol 喝酒
alcohol-free 不含酒精的
You must not drive after drinking alcohol.
(喝酒後絕對不可以開車。)
Clean the wound with alcohol first.
(先用酒精清潔傷口。)

alert(adj./v./n.)警覺的、使警覺、警報
alertness(n.)警覺
stay alert 保持警覺
on the alert 提高警覺
Drivers must stay alert on the road.
(駕駛人在路上必須保持警覺。)
The app alerts you when an earthquake is coming.
(這個應用程式會在地震來臨時向你發出警報。)

allowance(n.)零用錢、津貼、允許量
allow(v.)允許
weekly allowance 每週零用錢
make allowances for 體諒、考慮到
My parents give me a weekly allowance.
(我爸媽每週給我零用錢。)
The baggage allowance on this flight is 20 kilograms.
(這班飛機的行李限額是二十公斤。)

alternative(adj./n.)替代的、另類的、替代方案
alternatively(adv.)或者
alternative energy 替代能源
have no alternative 別無選擇
Solar power is a clean alternative to oil.
(太陽能是石油的乾淨替代能源。)
We had no alternative but to cancel the trip.
(我們別無選擇，只好取消旅行。)

amateur(adj./n.)業餘的、業餘愛好者
(無詞性變化)
amateur photographer 業餘攝影師
amateur team 業餘隊伍
He is an amateur, but his photos are amazing.
(他是業餘的，但他的照片很驚人。)
She plays in an amateur basketball team.
(她在一支業餘籃球隊打球。)

ambiguous(adj.)模稜兩可的、含糊的
ambiguity(n.)模稜兩可
ambiguous answer 模稜兩可的回答
ambiguous meaning 含糊的意思
His ambiguous answer made us more confused.
(他模稜兩可的回答讓我們更困惑。)
This sentence is ambiguous and needs to be rewritten.
(這個句子意思不明確，需要改寫。)

ambitious(adj.)有雄心的、野心勃勃的
ambition(n.)抱負、野心
ambitious goal 遠大的目標
ambitious plan 雄心勃勃的計畫
She is ambitious and wants to start her own company.
(她很有抱負，想創辦自己的公司。)
Finishing the project in a week is an ambitious goal.
(一週內完成這個專案是個遠大的目標。)

amuse(v.)逗樂、使開心、amusement(n.)娛樂、樂趣
amusing(adj.)有趣的
amused(adj.)覺得好笑的
amusement park 遊樂園
to one's amusement 令某人覺得好笑的是
The clown amused the children with funny tricks.
(小丑用滑稽的把戲逗樂孩子們。)
We spent the whole day at the amusement park.
(我們在遊樂園玩了一整天。)

analysis(n.)分析(複數 analyses)
analyze(v.)分析
analytical(adj.)分析的
data analysis 數據分析
in the final analysis 歸根究柢
The scientist did a careful analysis of the water.
(那位科學家仔細分析了這些水。)
Data analysis is an important skill today.
(數據分析是現今很重要的技能。)

analyze(v.)分析
analysis(n.)分析
analyst(n.)分析師
analyze data 分析數據
analyze the problem 分析問題
Let's analyze why we lost the game.
(我們來分析一下為什麼輸了比賽。)
The students analyzed the results of the experiment.
(學生們分析了實驗的結果。)

ancestor(n.)祖先
ancestral(adj.)祖先的
worship ancestors 祭祖
common ancestor 共同祖先
Many Taiwanese families honor their ancestors on Tomb Sweeping Day.
(許多台灣家庭在清明節祭拜祖先。)
My ancestors came from Fujian.
(我的祖先來自福建。)

anniversary(n.)週年紀念日
(無詞性變化)
wedding anniversary 結婚週年紀念
silver anniversary 二十五週年紀念
My parents celebrated their wedding anniversary at a nice restaurant.
(我爸媽在一家不錯的餐廳慶祝結婚週年。)
The school will celebrate its 60th anniversary next year.
(學校明年將慶祝六十週年校慶。)

annoy(v.)使煩惱、惹惱
annoyance(n.)惱怒
annoying(adj.)惱人的
annoyed(adj.)感到惱怒的
be annoyed with 對⋯生氣
annoying noise 惱人的噪音
His loud music really annoys me.
(他大聲放音樂真的讓我很煩。)
She was annoyed with her brother for taking her phone.
(她因為弟弟拿走她的手機而生氣。)

annual(adj.)每年的、年度的
annually(adv.)每年
annual meeting 年會
annual income 年收入
The school holds an annual sports day in November.
(學校每年十一月舉辦運動會。)
The festival is held annually in the spring.
(這個節慶每年春天舉行。)

anxiety(n.)焦慮、擔憂
anxious(adj.)焦慮的、渴望的
anxiously(adv.)焦急地
test anxiety 考試焦慮
feel anxiety about 對⋯感到焦慮
Many students feel anxiety before big exams.
(許多學生在大考前會感到焦慮。)
Deep breathing can help reduce anxiety.
(深呼吸可以幫助減輕焦慮。)

apology(n.)道歉
apologize(v.)道歉
apologetic(adj.)道歉的、愧疚的
make an apology 道歉
accept an apology 接受道歉
He made an apology for being late.
(他為遲到道歉。)
Please accept my sincere apology.
(請接受我誠摯的道歉。)

apparent(adj.)明顯的、表面上的
apparently(adv.)顯然、似乎
for no apparent reason 無緣無故
it is apparent that 顯然⋯
It was apparent that she was very tired.
(很明顯她非常疲累。)
The baby started crying for no apparent reason.
(寶寶無緣無故地哭了起來。)

applicant(n.)申請人
apply(v.)申請
application(n.)申請
job applicant 求職者
successful applicant 錄取者
There were over 100 applicants for the job.
(這份工作有超過一百位申請人。)
All applicants must take an interview.
(所有申請人都必須參加面試。)

application(n.)申請、應用、應用程式
apply(v.)申請、應用
applicant(n.)申請人
application form 申請表
fill out an application 填寫申請表
Please fill out the application form carefully.
(請仔細填寫申請表。)
This phone application helps you learn new words.
(這個手機應用程式能幫你學新單字。)

appoint(v.)任命、指定、appointment(n.)約會、預約、任命
(無詞性變化)
make an appointment 預約
be appointed as 被任命為
I made an appointment with the dentist for Friday.
(我預約了星期五看牙醫。)
She was appointed as the new principal.
(她被任命為新校長。)

appreciation(n.)感激、欣賞、增值
appreciate(v.)感激、欣賞
appreciative(adj.)感激的
in appreciation of 為了感謝⋯
art appreciation 藝術鑑賞
We gave him a card in appreciation of his help.
(我們送他一張卡片感謝他的幫忙。)
The course aims to develop students' music appreciation.
(這門課旨在培養學生的音樂欣賞能力。)

appropriate(adj.)適當的、合適的
appropriately(adv.)適當地
inappropriate(adj.)不適當的
appropriate for 適合⋯
appropriate behavior 合宜的行為
Jeans are not appropriate for a job interview.
(牛仔褲不適合穿去面試。)
Please choose an appropriate word to fill in the blank.
(請選一個適當的字填入空格。)

approval(n.)贊成、批准、認可
approve(v.)贊成、批准
with one's approval 經某人同意
seek approval 尋求認可
The plan needs the principal's approval.
(這個計畫需要校長的批准。)
Teenagers often seek approval from their friends.
(青少年經常尋求朋友的認同。)

aquarium(n.)水族館、魚缸
(無詞性變化)
visit an aquarium 參觀水族館
home aquarium 家用魚缸
We saw sharks and turtles at the aquarium.
(我們在水族館看到鯊魚和海龜。)
He keeps tropical fish in his aquarium.
(他在魚缸裡養熱帶魚。)

arch(n./v.)拱門、拱形、使成拱形
(無詞性變化)
stone arch 石拱門
arch one's back 拱起背
We walked under a beautiful stone arch.
(我們從一座美麗的石拱門下走過。)
The cat arched its back when it saw the dog.
(那隻貓看到狗時拱起了背。)

arise(v.)出現、發生、產生
(無詞性變化)
problems arise 問題出現
arise from 起因於
If any problems arise, call me at once.
(如果出現任何問題，馬上打電話給我。)
Many accidents arise from careless driving.
(許多事故起因於駕駛不小心。)

arms(n.)武器、軍火
arm(v.)武裝
armed(adj.)武裝的
arms race 軍備競賽
take up arms 拿起武器
The government stopped selling arms to that country.
(政府停止對那個國家出售武器。)
The two countries were in an arms race.
(那兩國當時正在進行軍備競賽。)

artificial(adj.)人造的、人工的、虛假的
artificially(adv.)人工地
artificial intelligence 人工智慧
artificial flowers 人造花
Artificial intelligence is changing the way we learn.
(人工智慧正在改變我們學習的方式。)
This juice contains no artificial colors.
(這種果汁不含人工色素。)

artistic(adj.)藝術的、有藝術天分的
art(n.)藝術
artist(n.)藝術家
artistic talent 藝術天分
artistic style 藝術風格
She has great artistic talent.
(她很有藝術天分。)
The café is decorated in an artistic style.
(那家咖啡廳裝潢得很有藝術風格。)

ashamed(adj.)感到羞恥的、慚愧的
shame(n.)羞恥
be ashamed of 對⋯感到羞愧
feel ashamed 感到慚愧
He felt ashamed of lying to his parents.
(他對向父母說謊感到很慚愧。)
You should never be ashamed of who you are.
(你永遠不該為自己是誰而感到羞愧。)

aspect(n.)方面、觀點、外觀
(無詞性變化)
every aspect of 各方面
an important aspect 重要的一面
Stress can affect every aspect of your life.
(壓力會影響你生活的各個方面。)
Let's look at the problem from a different aspect.
(我們從另一個角度來看這個問題。)

aspirin(n.)阿斯匹靈
(無詞性變化)
take an aspirin 吃一顆阿斯匹靈
aspirin tablet 阿斯匹靈錠
She took an aspirin for her headache.
(她吃了一顆阿斯匹靈止頭痛。)
Ask a doctor before giving aspirin to children.
(給孩童服用阿斯匹靈前要先問醫生。)

assemble(v.)集合、組裝
assembly(n.)集會、組裝
assemble furniture 組裝家具
assemble in 在⋯集合
All students assembled in the hall for the ceremony.
(所有學生在禮堂集合參加典禮。)

(我們花了兩小時組裝這個書架。)

assembly(n.)集會、議會、組裝
assemble(v.)集合、組裝
school assembly 朝會、全校集會
assembly line 裝配線
We have a school assembly every Monday morning.
(我們每週一早上有朝會。)
He works on an assembly line in a car factory.
(他在汽車工廠的裝配線上工作。)

assign(v.)分配、指派、assignment(n.)作業、任務
(無詞性變化)

hand in an assignment 交作業

(老師分配給我們一項小組專題。)

(別忘了在星期五前交作業。)

assistance(n.)協助、援助

be of assistance 有幫助

(如果你需要任何協助，請告訴我。)
The poor family received financial assistance from the city.
(那個貧困家庭獲得了市政府的經濟援助。)

associate(adj./n./v.)副的、夥伴、聯想、交往
association(n.)協會、關聯
be associated with 與⋯有關

Many people associate summer with the beach.
(很多人會把夏天和海灘聯想在一起。)

(吸菸與許多健康問題有關。)

association(n.)協會、聯合、關聯
associate(v.)聯想、交往

(這場活動是與當地學校合辦的。)

(她去年加入了學生會。)

assure(v.)保證、使確信
give an assurance 給予保證
quality assurance 品質保證
He gave me his assurance that he would help.
(他向我保證他會幫忙。)
She answered the questions with assurance.
(她很有把握地回答了這些問題。)

assure(v.)向⋯保證、使確信
assurance(n.)保證
assured(adj.)確定的、有把握的
assure... of 向⋯保證

I assure you that the food is fresh.
(我向你保證這食物很新鮮。)

(請放心，我們會好好照顧你的狗。)

athletic(adj.)運動的、體格健壯的

athletic shoes 運動鞋

(她的運動能力很強。)

atmosphere(n.)大氣、氣氛
atmospheric(adj.)大氣的、有氣氛的
friendly atmosphere 友善的氣氛
the earth's atmosphere 地球大氣層
The café has a warm and relaxing atmosphere.
(那家咖啡廳有溫暖放鬆的氣氛。)
Pollution is harming the earth's atmosphere.
(汙染正在危害地球的大氣層。)

atom(n.)原子、微量
atomic(adj.)原子的
hydrogen atom 氫原子
split the atom 分裂原子
Everything around us is made of atoms.
(我們周遭的一切都是由原子構成的。)

(一個水分子有兩個氫原子。)

atomic(adj.)原子的、原子能的
atom(n.)原子
atomic bomb 原子彈
atomic energy 原子能

(原子彈在1945年首次被使用。)

(科學家正在研究用原子能來發電。)

email attachment 電子郵件附件
Please attach a photo to your application.
(請在申請表上附一張照片。)
The child is very attached to his grandmother.
(那個孩子非常依戀他的奶奶。)

attraction(n.)吸引力、名勝
attract(v.)吸引

tourist attraction 觀光景點

authentic document 真實文件

(專家說這幅畫是真跡。)

autobiography(n.)自傳

(那位歌手去年出版了他的自傳。)

autograph book 簽名簿

(粉絲們等了好幾個小時要他的簽名。)

(作者在她的新書上簽名。)
